name: Annikki Korhonen
bio:
Annikki's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, through her passion for automotive restoration. Growing up in a small village near Jyväskylä, she spent countless hours in her grandfather's workshop, learning the intricacies of bodywork and paint application. After completing her vocational training in vehicle painting, she sought opportunities to apply her skills in a high-performance environment.

She joined Richard Childress Racing after a successful stint with a smaller European rally team. Annikki is meticulous and understands the importance of a flawless finish, not just for aesthetics but also for aerodynamic performance. Her ability to adapt to new paint technologies and her unwavering commitment to quality make her an invaluable asset to the team. She thrives on the challenge of matching complex color schemes and creating custom finishes that stand out on the track.

Annikki is known for her proactive approach to problem-solving and her ability to work under pressure. She is constantly seeking ways to improve efficiency and reduce waste in the paint shop, ensuring that the team stays ahead of the competition.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided pigtails that she often tucks under a cap
physical.description: Annikki is slender and has a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always has a small, detailed model car on her workbench.
Listens to Finnish folk music through noise-canceling headphones while working.
Meticulously cleans her spray guns after every use, regardless of how busy the shop is.
